annotations.title: Caption styles and each place's margins

description: Use it when the user wants the caption styles, or the margins an app's buttons leave free. Lists easycaptionkit's caption styles with what each suits, its options, and every place's margins, in pixels of the screen or frame they are for, each with its source and the day it was read. It reads no file and runs no browser or ffmpeg. Use it to pick a style and the places for caption_video, or to tell the user where an app's buttons sit. The captions playbook (makersmcp_playbook) has the whole job. (easycaptionkit 0.1.5, on this machine.)

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the result, counted from the start of the call, before returning a job_id to wait on. Some clients end a call after 60 or 240 seconds; 45 is safe in all of them.
